fields.PRODUCT NAME: Rajasthani Handcrafted Ceramic Tile Wall Hook
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a touch of traditional elegance to your home with this beautifully handcrafted Rajasthani wall hook. Featuring vibrant blue and orange floral motifs on ceramic tiles, framed with sturdy wrought iron, this piece is both decorative and functional. Perfect for hanging keys, clothes, or accessories, it brings the charm of Rajasthan’s rich art and culture into your living space. Each piece is uniquely hand-painted, making it a timeless addition to your home décor or a thoughtful gift for loved ones.
